intro: Echo Park wraps around its lake, with swan boats and a palm-lined loop, and Sunset Boulevard runs through it with some of the Eastside's best bars, taquerias and music rooms. Dodger Stadium sits right above it in Chavez Ravine.

inf: The Infatuation: Best restaurants and bars in Echo Park
to: Time Out: Best restaurants in Echo Park
fod: Fodor's: Best restaurants in Echo Park
gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)

places.w: A bright, roomy cafe with free Wi-Fi, great croissants and no charge for alternative milks.
places.o: A lavender latte and a savory pastry. Park up on Kensington and take the stairs down.

places.w: A small, sunny roaster's cafe with a long bar and very fresh beans to take home.
places.o: A cappuccino or the fig leaf latte. There's no Wi-Fi.

places.w: A relaxed neighborhood coffee bar that's been on Sunset for more than a decade.
places.o: An iced matcha on the patio.

places.w: A tiny bakery and sandwich shop with a tree-shaded patio, famous for its pies and petit fours.
places.o: A hand pie or the Basque cheesecake, plus the prosciutto sandwich.

places.w: A neighborhood American spot that works for a sandwich lunch or a full dinner.
places.o: The mushroom dip at lunch; beef tartare toast and roast chicken at dinner.

places.w: Modern Mexican cooking with a patio built for cocktails.
places.o: Blue corn tacos and the duck confit with date mole.

places.w: A Peruvian-Japanese ceviche bar where most dishes are under $20.
places.o: Nikkei sashimi, a scallop hand roll and the shrimp dumplings.

places.w: A red-sauce Italian room with icy martinis.
places.o: Chicken parm and the lasagna bolognese.

places.w: A cozy Japanese izakaya known for yakitori and sake.
places.o: Chicken oyster skewers and the garlic fried rice with Dungeness crab.

places.w: Tsubaki's casual sake bar next door, made for sharing plates.
places.o: The Osaka-style okonomiyaki and a sake flight.

places.w: A Mediterranean bar and restaurant with a hidden alley entrance and an easy weeknight feel.
places.o: Small plates and the branzino.

places.w: A Roman-inspired Italian restaurant with a big wood-framed dining room and patio, and one of the best Italian meals in LA.
places.o: Pasta at dinner, cottage cheese pancakes at brunch. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

places.w: A true neighborhood pizzeria, with blistered pies and a lively room.
places.o: A pizza and the fried mozzarella.

places.w: A long-running spot famous for Chicago-style deep-dish pizza.
places.o: Order the deep dish when you sit down; it takes a while.

places.w: Buttery pan pizza in a retro dining room.
places.o: The pepperoni pan pie, eaten in.

places.w: A small, dependable Mediterranean restaurant where vegetables are the stars.
places.o: The vegetable plates and the lamb kebab.

places.w: Tijuana-style tacos off the trompo, worth the long line.
places.o: Al pastor and the crispy fried cheese taco.

places.w: A street cart making handmade Oaxacan quesadillas with creative fillings.
places.o: A huitlacoche quesadilla. Open Friday through Monday.

places.w: Filipino flavors meet Southern barbecue.
places.o: Coconut beef adobo, tri-tip and bibingka for dessert.

places.w: A retro soda fountain for ice cream.
places.o: The banana split or pistachio.

places.w: A warm, wood-paneled cocktail bar with Mediterranean food, a vintage sound system and a leafy patio.
places.o: The lavender cocktail with the watermelon salad.

places.w: A moody, velvet-lined cocktail bar with deep whiskey and agave lists, near Dodger Stadium.
places.o: Go on a weeknight for an easy conversation.

places.w: An upstairs bar with a lovely patio and some of the best margaritas on the Eastside.
places.o: The tequila sour before a Dodgers game.

places.w: A palm-ringed lake with swan pedal boats, a fountain and a walking loop. The lotus bed blooms each summer.
places.o: Rent a swan boat at sunset.

places.w: A small, dark music room where you can get right up to the band.
places.o: Check the calendar for local and touring acts.

places.w: The Dodgers' hilltop home in Chavez Ravine, right above the neighborhood.
places.o: Eat and drink on Sunset before the game and walk up.
